**Longest:** 120 h — (−)-α-bisabolol production by *S. marcescens* HBQA7 → LMB12 (fed-batch, pathway reconstruction and enhancement of enzyme solubility; 30,200 mg L⁻¹) (Table 2, p. 9). The next longest is 110 h for the (−)-α-bisabolol strain SMB19 (102,300 mg L⁻¹), and 108 h for prodigiosin in strain SK4–72 (p. 9).

**Shortest:** 6 h — the two whole-cell biocatalyst entries using strain MG1 → MG1ABC: acetoin via an NAD⁺ regeneration system (44,900 mg L⁻¹) and 2,3-butanediol via an NADH regeneration system (27,950 mg L⁻¹) (Table 2, p. 9).
